{{Quote|Had I possessed this as a child, I could have saved the life of my Master. I see that Mother Talzin guards her treasures jealously.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''Talisman of Resurrection''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] talisman that could bring the spirits of the [[Death/Legends|dead]], back to their physical bodies. It was advised that this talisman be used shortly after the person had died, or their forms would be little more than fetid [[Bone/Legends|skeletons]]. Though it was temporary, it allowed for fellow Nightsisters to learn the cause of their sister's demise.<ref name="BoS" />
